name: Iceland
hook: Sagas, volcanoes and the world's oldest parliament, just below the Arctic Circle.

facts.label: Reykjavik
facts.statement: Reykjavik, Iceland's capital, means "Bay of Smokes" and was founded around 874.

facts.label: Erik the Red
facts.statement: Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland and in 982 sailed to Greenland, where he founded a colony.

facts.label: the Althing
facts.statement: Iceland's parliament is the Althing, whose name means "whole assembly" and which dates to the Viking age.

facts.label: geothermal energy
facts.statement: Most Icelandic houses are heated with geothermal energy, and the island's volcanoes and geysers are powered by that heat.

facts.label: Denmark
facts.statement: Iceland was ruled by Denmark and celebrates its independence from it on June 17.

facts.label: Vigdis Finnbogadottir
facts.statement: Vigdis Finnbogadottir became Iceland's first female president in 1980.

facts.label: Journey to the Center of the Earth
facts.statement: Jules Verne's Journey to the Center of the Earth begins with a descent into Iceland's Mount Snaefells.
associations: Journey to the Center of the Earth
